content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DHS Coimbatore Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://coimbatore.nic.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 17-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026 is 17 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by the District Health Society Coimbatore for the posts of Microbiologist and Driver.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026 is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Microbiologist post?
faq.answer: For the Microbiologist post, candidates should possess an M.D. Microbiology or Ph.D. in Medical Microbiology/Applied Microbiology/General Microbiology, or an M.Sc. in Medical Microbiology/Applied Microbiology/General Microbiology with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The Driver post offers a salary of Rs. 17500/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026 primarily involves Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the District Health Society Coimbatore (DHS Coimbatore).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can typically be found on the official website of the District Health Society Coimbatore. Links are provided in the "Important Links" section.
